detail: User authorized continuous PM, architecture and development work toward an installable real-Agent product with secure Web and Mobile operation. Phase 4 localhost read-only mechanics remain the frozen baseline; synthetic work cannot unlock real-agent or production gates.

The first shippable persona is a solo developer on Apple Silicon macOS using a secure desktop or mobile browser. Native iPhone and APNs move to a later gate; the first Alpha must install, run a real agent, show live state, recover and support only the independently approved action subset.

Repository-local Web Companion, installability and protocol work are separated from real Provider evidence, production identity and publication trust, and real-device/APNs gates. Reply, deny and Stop are the candidate first actions; allow_once remains blocked on SEC-003, SEC-004 and HC-015.

Before a real installable OpenCode product, root exports, startup authorization and journal persistence must stop mixing neutral core with stock OpenCode types. A generic multi-agent trait can wait, but OpenCode install/start must become an explicit adapter-owned package.

The first launcher worker produced no owned-file delta across two monitoring intervals. Ownership moved to a fresh implementation worker under the same frozen contract instead of repeating the stalled direction.

A second worker also produced no launcher delta. The package was structurally split into a doctor, manifest and state contract subpackage plus a separately owned process lifecycle subpackage; clean-home integration remains the join gate.

P0/P1/P2 zero after lexical home, symlink, lifecycle lock, process-group identity, degraded reconcile, canary secret, unowned uninstall and orphan cleanup rework. Seven clean-home tests pass and no child remains.

The repo-local launcher foundation is frozen but is not an installer because start still builds from source and requires the development toolchain. The next package must materialize and consume a prebuilt local bundle before any installable product claim.

The prebuilt-bundle architecture task produced no report across repeated waits. The orchestrator froze the minimal manifest and runtime contract directly and dispatched implementation to avoid another planning loop.

P0/P1/P2 zero after canonical manifest, exact file and directory set, symlink and mode rejection, isolated PYTHONPATH, exclusive publication and private verified runtime snapshot rework. The bundle runtime needs Python and Node but no Go, Cargo, npm or source checkout.

OpenCode containment is split into public API namespace, startup authorization and journal ownership packages. The first package moves adapter exports behind adapters::opencode without changing runtime behavior; a generic multi-agent trait remains deferred.

The first real user version is Apple Silicon macOS Host plus desktop/mobile Web Companion. It requires a locked official Provider-backed OpenCode run and same-run evidence; launch actions are view, reply, deny and Stop, while allow_once remains false.

Go requires clean-machine prebuilt installation, actionable doctor/start, same-run official real-Agent evidence, desktop and real-phone Web attachment, exactly-once reply/deny/Stop, secret-safe operation, release/security gates, and owned cleanup. Foundation or synthetic evidence remains No-Go.

P0/P1/P2 zero after moving OpenCode, stock and startup authority exports below adapters::opencode. Rustdoc compile-fail proves legacy root imports fail; fmt, clippy and complete Cargo tests pass. Journal behavior remains a separate gate.

The new strict boundary accepts only the committed official id/type/properties envelope and verified event-name set, rejects upstream seq or durable claims, and returns ShapeObservedUnmapped until lifecycle property semantics are independently evidenced.

P0/P1/P2 zero after bundling the exact official opencode-ai 1.18.16 Darwin arm64 executable, enforcing the committed raw digest, passing Provider bytes through an anonymous FD to the exec bootstrap, pre-spawn byte-count gating, and guaranteed kill/reap on identity failure. Seventeen nomad-web tests pass. Continuous projection, command authority and production identity remain blocked.

Legacy process_bridge, permission and stop entrypoints cannot be product write authority because they lack authenticated device, epoch, current snapshot and full target binding. The product path must expose one crate-private Host authority for reply, deny and Stop; allow_once and interrupt-and-send remain outside release scope.

P0/P1/P2 zero after adding pre-parse non-recursive depth and node budgets. The projector exposes only content-safe aliases, state, time and diff count and remains explicitly not Provider lifecycle evidence.

P0/P1/P2 zero after production clock ownership, SQLite FULL durability, scope reconciliation gates, opaque single-use reconciliation proof, principal-bound domain-separated MACs and zeroization. This freezes only the crate-private foundation, not product wiring.

P0/P1/P2 zero. Public Web request DTOs are exactly reply, deny and stop, use observed_seq only as a freshness CAS input, cannot carry Host status or results, and runtime validation rejects legacy, polluted or incomplete requests.

Initial C1 audit found ambient proxy leakage of the Agent Basic credential plus framing, response-schema, workspace-binding and child-reaping gaps. Rework now uses proxy-disabled exact loopback requests, EOF-before-ACK framing, strict responses, same-opened-workspace identity and deterministic reap; final re-audit is pending.
P0/P1/P2 zero after exact runtime validation was aligned with the request-only schema. Browser requests use observed_seq solely as a freshness CAS claim and cannot carry Host status or results.

P0/P1/P2 zero. OutcomeUnknown scope gates can be cleared only by a sealed single-use reconciliation proof bound to identity, request, terminal outcome and authoritative snapshot; ordinary refresh cannot clear the gate.

C1 proxy, strict response, EOF framing and reap findings are closed. One P1 remains: the Agent must fchdir the same verified workspace directory FD rather than reopen its pathname. Real inherited-FD inventory evidence is also required before freeze.

P0/P1/P2 zero after disabling ambient proxies, enforcing EOF before ACK, strict health and session responses, deterministic reap, and carrying the exact verified workspace directory FD through child fchdir. This freezes same-run ownership only, not projector or commands.

P0/P1/P2 zero for the final C2 delta: run/workspace/process binding is consumed and fatal on replacement; the claim is limited to a bounded stable-observation window; seq=1 precedes ready; the monotonic lease is 60 seconds; UDS inode identity is end-to-end; same-instance gaps cannot jump through current; raw route bytes are zeroized. C2 E3 two-run real-browser acceptance remains NOT_RUN.

Fresh current-disk audit returned PASS/FREEZE with no P0/P1 for local view, safe-summary reply, generic deny and Stop. Two visible-control mechanical E2 runs passed with one upstream call per command, zero replay effects, OutcomeUnknown without automatic retry, private journal and UDS permissions, privacy scans and owned cleanup. Provider E3 and remote phone remain NOT_RUN.

SECURE_COMMAND_AUTHORITY is removed only from the official local runtime blocker set. PRODUCTION_DEVICE_IDENTITY remains. The next repo-owned vertical slice is real device registry, pairing epoch and revocation authority, followed by a content-blind Relay path and authenticated remote Gateway. All allowlisted Provider credential variables were absent, so real Provider E3 is externally blocked rather than passed.

A1 PASS/FREEZE with no P0/P1 after rework: active rows retain only public-key digests; terminal pending rows clear raw public keys; pairing explicitly binds challenge bytes through a domain-separated digest and complete proof transcript; a persistent time floor prevents clock-rollback resurrection; signed-64-bit epochs, BEGIN IMMEDIATE and tombstones preserve concurrency and restart safety; SQLite uses exact private path and files, NOFOLLOW, inode checks, WAL, FULL and secure_delete. A2 Product Host linearization is still pending.

A2a PASS/FREEZE with no P0/P1. Four local device administration routes share FD11 HMAC, nonce and strict framing; local-run command authority remains byte-compatible and does not auto-pair; remote registry facts have no command ingress; persistent registry restart, stop-preserve and safe-uninstall behavior are covered. Future remote revoke/command linearization remains an explicit A2b gate.

M1a and M1b PASS/FREEZE after closing strict ACK parsing, expiry cleanup, 30-day tombstone lifecycle, provisioning-file no-follow ownership checks and graceful shutdown. V2 uses separate tables/routes, fixed listener roles, direction-bound digest-only bearer auth, canonical opaque frames, durable sequence and ACK high-water marks, irreversible revoke, WAL/FULL and explicit loopback/TLS boundaries. No Host/browser crypto join exists yet.

M2 PASS/FREEZE with no P0/P1. Rust and WebCrypto implement P-256 ECDH, HKDF-SHA256 direction keys, AES-256-GCM, P-256 ECDSA P1363 signatures, deterministic direction/sequence nonce, canonical AAD and padded canonical JSON. A checked-in TEST_ONLY_VECTOR is decrypted by both implementations and a Rust-produced frame is decrypted by Web. No Host/Relay/browser runtime join exists yet.
